notes.title: Android Companion App Available!
notes.notes:
The AR companion app is officially on the play store. ːcupupː
[b]LINK:[/b] https://bit.ly/35EJ3ld

If you have any issues don't hesitate to leave a comment and well do our best to help!
We hope you love our game! we cant wait to hear back from you!
